text:
Priya Patel: Morning — noticed a jump in per-route burn for gen-text routes in ap-northeast-1 overnight. Dashboard shows +48% spend vs baseline but reserved capacity utilization only ~62%. https://dash.redwood.internal/finops/per-route

Ethan Kim: :eyes: saw the alert too. billing-bot posted an anomaly at ~03:12 UTC. Starting with tag and model-sku checks.

billing-bot: [anomaly] cost_spike detected. route=gen-text, region=ap-northeast-1, delta=+47.9%, window=2026-03-17T00:00:00Z/2026-03-17T06:00:00Z. auto-notify(finops).

Asha Rao: Could be fallback traffic to on-demand or a new model variant with more vram. Priya — can you paste the route -> model mapping from last night’s deploy?

Priya Patel: pasted mapping from deploy log:
```
route: gen-text -> model:v2.3.1-quant;
route: gen-quick -> model:v2.2.0;
route: embed -> model:embed-small-v1;
```
Also ran a quick BQ extraction:
```
SELECT route, model_name, SUM(billed_tokens) AS tokens, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM `billing.dataset.model_usage`
WHERE region='ap-northeast-1' AND DATE(usage_time) = '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY route, model_name
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

Ethan Kim: Results show gen-text cost concentrated on model:v2.3.1-quant and a lot of short sessions (mean seq_len low, high idle time). I also see ~18% of instances in that region missing the "team:embed-team" tag so reserved attribution split.

Asha Rao: That tag mismatch would leak on-demand charges into gen-text bucket. Two actions: 1) patch tagging (small job), 2) simulate reassigning reserved capacity from embed -> gen-text for April commit. I ran a quick simulation (link) and shifting 30% of Japan reserved q3 would cut on-demand exposure by ~35% and reduce unit-cost by ~22%.

Priya Patel: Good — I’ll open a short-term reserved adjustment request and a follow-up incident for tagging. Drafted commit note: "Propose temporary 30% reallocation of ap-northeast reserved GPUs from embed to gen-text for 30 days to hedge spike".

Ethan Kim: Also suggesting an autoscaler tweak: raise packing window from 45s -> 90s to reduce churn and better fill reserved pools. I can PR this to eng-infra. Command I ran to check pod churn:
```
kubectl get pods --namespace=gen-text -o json | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, age: .status.startTime}' | wc -l
```

Asha Rao: Nice. Invite finance to the simulation review call at 16:00 PT. If tagging patch is quick we can do the reserved reallocation as a short commit (30-day) instead of long-term.

Priya Patel: @Ethan please add the autoscaler tweak to the PR and tag eng-infra/eng-sre. I’ll file the short commit and add the cost-sim screenshots to the request. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Ethan Kim: on it. will follow up in #eng-infra with the PR link and postmortem notes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

billing-bot: [note] ticket FINOPS-421 created for "ap-northeast-1 gen-text on-demand leakage".
